longForm.heroLead: Scale up evaporation without overcomplicating your setup. When benchtop evaporation is no longer enough, the Heidolph Hei-VAP Industrial Rotary Evaporator helps laboratories move into larger batch volumes with a practical, cost-focused industrial configuration. The confirmed configuration is Hei-VAP Industrial with glassware A, P/N 518-13100-00. It includes one descending condenser, one expansion vessel, one 20 L evaporating flask, and one 10 L receiving flask. It is designed for teams handling larger solvent volumes, pilot-scale distillation, solvent recovery, and concentration workflows where bath capacity, vacuum performance, cooling supply, and safe handling all need to be planned together.

products.overview: Your rotary evaporator stops every time someone has to refill a flask. This module means it does not have to.
features: Sensor or Time-Controlled Filling: Refilling the rotary flask is easy. Doing it every fifteen minutes is not. The module fills the flask either when a sensor detects that liquid is needed or at a time interval you program, so the distillation keeps moving without anyone returning to the bench.

Approx. 330 mL Coated Collector Vessel: A full collector is normally the point at which the process stops. The coated collector vessel holds approximately 330 mL and is emptied automatically on the schedule you set, so the next cycle starts without you.
Integrated Compressor: The compressor that empties the collector is built into the control box. There is no external compressed air line to source, plumb, or maintain.

Removable 7-Inch Touchscreen Control Panel: Filling parameters, collector emptying time, automatic cleaning, and manual operation are all entered on one removable 7 inch touchscreen. Automation should not add a second interface to learn.

Animated Process Display: The animated, easy-to-read screen shows which step is currently running, and a colour scheme tells you what is happening at any moment. You can see the state of the process before you decide whether it needs you.

Illuminated Control Knobs: The illuminated control knobs show from across the laboratory whether the system is being aerated, is under vacuum, or is under overpressure. Status you can read at a glance is status you will actually check.
Automatic Cleaning Mode: Preparing for the next process should not become another manual routine. Automatic cleaning is started directly from the touchscreen, which shortens turnaround between runs.
Manual Operation Mode: When a process needs direct control, manual operation is available from the same screen. Automation is the default, not the only option.

Chemical-Resistant Media Contact Parts: All parts that come into contact with the media, including the supplied tubing, are made of chemical-resistant materials. Your solvent list can change without the module becoming the limiting factor.

Direct Hei-VAP Benchtop Mounting: The control box with its integrated compressor mounts directly onto a Hei-VAP benchtop rotary evaporator using the bracket supplied. Adding automation does not mean redesigning the bench.
Compact Control Box: At 186 x 429 x 521 mm including the control panel and approximately 17 kg, the module keeps the automation close to the instrument instead of spreading it across the workspace.

Unattended Overnight and Weekend Operation: In combination with the corresponding evaporator system, the module enables efficient unattended operation. Solvents and solvent waste can be processed overnight and over the weekend, which is where the cost case usually lives.

Residue Drainage Configuration Choice: The module can be specified according to process need, including a version without automated residue drainage. The configuration follows your process rather than the other way round.

faqs.question: What is the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro used for?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is a Heidolph continuous automatic distillation module used to automate solvent recovery and continuous distillation on a compatible Hei-VAP benchtop rotary evaporator. It automatically fills the rotary flask, empties the collector vessel using an integrated compressor, and repeats the cycle, so long runs continue without an operator at the bench.

faqs.question: Which rotary evaporator is the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro compatible with?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is compatible with a Hei-VAP benchtop rotary evaporator, onto which the control box and its integrated compressor mount directly using the bracket supplied. Inkarp confirms compatibility against your existing Hei-VAP configuration before quotation.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro?
faqs.answer: The part number of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is 591-62230-00, supplied as the Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro Benchtop G9BXL. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this Heidolph configuration in India.

faqs.question: How does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro fill the rotary flask?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro fills the rotary flask by either sensor-controlled or time-controlled filling, selected on the removable 7 inch touchscreen control panel. Sensor control responds to the actual flask level, while time control follows an interval you program.

faqs.question: What is the collector vessel capacity of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro has a coated collector vessel of approximately 330 mL. The integrated compressor empties it on a time you program from the touchscreen, so the next distillation cycle begins without manual draining.

faqs.question: Does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro need an external compressed air supply?
faqs.answer: No, the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro does not need an external compressed air supply, because the compressor that empties the collector vessel is integrated into the control box. This keeps the installation compact and removes the need to plumb a separate air line.

faqs.question: Can the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro run unattended overnight?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is designed for unattended operation, and in combination with the corresponding evaporator system it allows solvents and solvent waste to be processed overnight and over weekends. Automatic filling, automatic collector emptying, and repeat cycles remove the interventions that normally stop a run.

faqs.question: Is the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro suitable for aggressive solvents?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is built so that every part in contact with the media, including the supplied tubing, is made of chemical-resistant material, which supports a wide range of laboratory solvents. Share your solvent list with Inkarp to confirm suitability for your specific application.

faqs.question: Does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro have an automatic cleaning mode?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro has an automatic cleaning mode that is started directly from the removable 7 inch touchscreen, alongside automatic and manual operation. This shortens turnaround between distillation runs.

faqs.question: What power supply does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro require?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro requires 100 to 240 V AC at 50/60 Hz, with an L+N+PE connection, a maximum power input of 1,500 W, and a 15 A fuse. It carries IP42 protection to EN 60529.

faqs.question: What are the dimensions and weight of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro measures 186 x 429 x 521 mm including the control panel and weighs approximately 17 kg. Confirm bench space next to your Hei-VAP rotary evaporator before installation.
